title: Grim Reaper in Surreal Void
description: A skeletal grim reaper wearing a dark fedora and tattered coat holds a smoking revolver in one hand and a large glowing Nike swoosh in the other. To the right, a giant iridescent beetle bears a glowing golden Gucci logo while a fiery black hole with orbiting text and debris dominates the dark cosmic background.
prompt: A skeletal grim reaper in a dripping fedora and trench coat stands in a dark swirling tunnel, holding a smoking revolver in one hand and a bright white glowing Nike swoosh in the other, a giant metallic green beetle with glowing golden Gucci logo on its back beside him, massive fiery black hole with purple rings and floating text fragments in the sky, dark cinematic lighting, surreal nightmare aesthetic
